reports.description:
I invested $500,and watched the algorithm gather the return which was promised to be 10x. As the amount grew I requested my original deposit be returned to my account thinking the return would cover the requested 20% for using the service. My request was denied in spite of the claims that withdrawals were always available, and would be quickly approved. I took screenshot of the progress, and inquired as to why the return itself could not be used to cover the fee, if the money was real, and I was told this is how the business has always operated.  
The amount grew to $6,210, and I was told that I would need an outside source of funding to pay the fee in order to release the return._x000D_
I did notice the brokers nickname on Facebook was Innocent Jack which was suspicious to me because innocent people dont usually need to proclaim such without being questioned. I was hoping to gain access to a resource to help pay for my wedding, but it seems this one was too good to be true._x000D_
I informed the broker that I was reaching out to get the fee, but I realize this smells bad to me. I already lost $500 and now they want $1,142 more. I will like to recover my money, but even more to help put this website out of commission._x000D_
I have the bitcoin address 1KsxMEskonhDie11jiTLXev3Mib4dzarJm _x000D_
and snapshots of the trading.
